text:
Controlling for inflation and PPP, Japan's GDP per capita rose roughly 8- to 10-fold between 1950 and 2016—from around $3,000–4,000 (2011 int'l dollars) to about $38,000–40,000. Most of this gain occurred during the high-growth era of the 1950s–1970s, with slower growth after the 1990s.  
CONFIDENCE: 80
